messages.content: You are BioGPT, an expert compiler architect. Translate the provided natural language biological protocol into valid, deterministic BioScript code for execution on a microfluidic biochip.

PROTOCOL: Digital Microfluidic G6PD Deficiency Assay
Module: fluorescence

MANIFEST:
- whole_blood
- diluent
- g6pd_reagent_1
- g6pd_reagent_2

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. wb = dispense 20 units of whole_blood
2. d1 = dispense 40 units of diluent
3. lysate = mix wb with d1 for 30s
4. repeat 3 times:
   - d2 = dispense 40 units of diluent
   - lysate = mix lysate with d2 for 30s
5. r1 = dispense g6pd_reagent_1
6. rxn1 = mix lysate with r1 for 30s
7. r2 = dispense g6pd_reagent_2
8. g6pd_rxn = mix rxn1 with r2 for 30s
9. heat g6pd_rxn at 37c for 1m (60s)
10. g6pd_signal = detect fluorescence on g6pd_rxn for 10s
11. if (g6pd_signal <= 2):
    - dispose g6pd_rxn
12. repeat 23 times:
    - g6pd_signal = detect fluorescence on g6pd_rxn for 10s
13. dispose g6pd_rxn

module fluorescence

manifest whole_blood
manifest diluent
manifest g6pd_reagent_1
manifest g6pd_reagent_2

instructions:

wb = dispense 20 units of whole_blood
d1 = dispense 40 units of diluent
lysate = mix wb with d1 for 30s

repeat 3 times {
    d2 = dispense 40 units of diluent
    lysate = mix lysate with d2 for 30s
}

r1 = dispense g6pd_reagent_1
rxn1 = mix lysate with r1 for 30s

r2 = dispense g6pd_reagent_2
g6pd_rxn = mix rxn1 with r2 for 30s

heat g6pd_rxn at 37c for 1m

g6pd_signal = detect fluorescence on g6pd_rxn for 10s

if (g6pd_signal <= 2) {
    dispose g6pd_rxn
}

repeat 23 times {
    g6pd_signal = detect fluorescence on g6pd_rxn for 10s
}

dispose g6pd_rxn

ir.content:
main:
	wb1[0] = dispense(whole_blood)
	d11[0] = dispense(diluent)
	lysate1[0] = mix(wb1[0], d11[0]) @ 30.0SECOND
bsbbr_2_h:
	PHI REPEAT_31 = {REPEAT_30,REPEAT_32}
	PHI d21 = {d20,d22}
	PHI lysate2 = {lysate1,lysate3}
	if REPEAT_31[0] > 0	|	true: jump bsbbr_3_t	|	false: jump bsbbr_4_f
bsbbr_3_t:
	d22[0] = dispense(diluent)
	lysate3[0] = mix(lysate2[0], d22[0]) @ 30.0SECOND
	REPEAT_32[0] = REPEAT_31[0] - 1
bsbbr_4_f:
	r11[0] = dispense(g6pd_reagent_1)
	rxn11[0] = mix(lysate2[0], r11[0]) @ 30.0SECOND
	r21[0] = dispense(g6pd_reagent_2)
	g6pd_rxn1[0] = mix(rxn11[0], r21[0]) @ 30.0SECOND
	heat(g6pd_rxn1[0]) @ 37.0CELSIUS @ 60.0SECOND
	g6pd_signal1[0] = detect(fluorescence, g6pd_rxn1[0]) @ 10.0SECOND
	if g6pd_signal1[0] <= 2	|	true: jump bsbbif_5_t	|	false: jump bsbbif_6_f
bsbbif_5_t:
	dispose(g6pd_rxn1[0])
bsbbif_6_f:
	PHI g6pd_rxn2 = {g6pd_rxn1,g6pd_rxn}
bsbbr_7_h:
	PHI REPEAT_231 = {REPEAT_230,REPEAT_232}
	PHI g6pd_signal2 = {g6pd_signal1,g6pd_signal3}
	if REPEAT_231[0] > 0	|	true: jump bsbbr_8_t	|	false: jump bsbbr_9_f
bsbbr_8_t:
	g6pd_signal3[0] = detect(fluorescence, g6pd_rxn2[0]) @ 10.0SECOND
	REPEAT_232[0] = REPEAT_231[0] - 1
bsbbr_9_f:
	dispose(g6pd_rxn2[0])
	NOP
